steps.name: Login request
steps.goal: If the system Home screen is visible, open omg. Wait for the website login card. Once the card is visible, only observe it. Do not tap its buttons in this step.
steps.done: The website login request card is one row: the site, a Log in button, and a cross to dismiss it.

steps.name: Native browser
steps.goal: Open the native browser by tapping Log in only if the card is still visible. Once Use login is visible below the page, wait for the test page. Do not tap Use login or Transfer login in this step.
steps.done: The native browser is open with compact header controls and a full-width Use login button below the page. This step does not sign in or transfer anything.

steps.name: Website sign-in
steps.goal: Tap Sign in to test site in the web page

steps.name: Transfer consent
steps.goal: Tap the full-width Use login button below the web page
steps.done: A native alert asks permission to transfer the login
expect: Use this login on your computer?

steps.name: Approved transfer
steps.goal: Tap Transfer login to approve the login transfer
steps.done: The transfer finished and the agent was notified, so the login row is gone. The chat carries the outcome as its own Signed in row. Only the test page title remains.
